events_public_catalog_idx.name: events_public_catalog_idx
events_public_catalog_idx.where: "events"."visibility" = 'public' and "events"."published_at" is not null and "events"."slug" is not null

events_slug_format_check.name: events_slug_format_check
events_slug_format_check.value: "events"."slug" is null or (char_length("events"."slug") between 3 and 80 and "events"."slug" ~ '^[a-z0-9]+(-[a-z0-9]+)*$')

events_public_requires_slug_and_publishe.name: events_public_requires_slug_and_published_at_check
events_public_requires_slug_and_publishe.value: "events"."visibility" <> 'public' or ("events"."slug" is not null and "events"."published_at" is not null)

operator_users_suspension_state_check.name: operator_users_suspension_state_check
operator_users_suspension_state_check.value:
(
        ("operator_users"."suspended_at" is null and "operator_users"."suspension_reason" is null and "operator_users"."suspended_by_operator_id" is null)
        or
        (
          "operator_users"."suspended_at" is not null
          and "operator_users"."suspension_reason" is not null
          and char_length("operator_users"."suspension_reason") between 1 and 500
          and "operator_users"."suspension_reason" = btrim("operator_users"."suspension_reason")
          and "operator_users"."suspended_by_operator_id" is not null
        )
      )
